verses.gurmukhi: ੭ : ਕੁਦਰਤ ਦਾ ਭੇਤ ਕਾਦਰ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਹੈ
verses.translit_en: 7 : kudharat dhaa bhet kaadhar jaanadhaa hai

en.bdb: Only Creator knows the mystery of creation

verses.gurmukhi: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਥਿਤਿ ਨ ਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਮਾਹੁ ਜਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: oa(n)kaar akaar kar thit na vaar na maahu janaiaa|

en.bdb: About the day and month of the creation, the Creator has told nothing to anybody.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਨ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: nira(n)kaar aakaar vin eka(n)kaar na alakh lakhaiaa|

en.bdb: The Formless One who resided in His own self did not make anybody see His imperceptible form.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਉਂ ਧਰਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: aape aap upai kai aape aapanaa naau(n) dharaiaa|

en.bdb: Himself He created all and Himself He (for the weal of creatures) established His name in their hearts.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਹੈ ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਹੋਂਦਾ ਆਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: aadh purakh aadhes hai hai bhee hosee ho(n)dhaa aaiaa|

en.bdb: I bow before that primal Lord, who is there in the present, who will remain in the future and who was in the beginning as well.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ਬਿਅੰਤੁ ਹੈ ਆਪ ਆਪਿ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: aadh na a(n)t bia(n)t hai aap aap na aap ganaiaa|

en.bdb: He is beyond beginning, beyond end and is infinite; but He never makes Himself noticed.
He created the world and Himself subsumes it in His self.
